standards.initial: Findings in inspector-only history routing, selection publication before command acceptance, unsafe test lookup, stale ABI comment, avoidable static geometry copies, schema-constant assertion
standards.resolution: Inspector registers through existing HistoryController; selection uses existing selectElement only after accepted publication; test lookup is nullable; ABI comment current; sampler visits authored channels and only detaches changed values; constant pin removed
standards.rejected: Checkbox binding loss was not reproduced: native toggle/undo/selection test passed without a binding-reset workaround. No new empty-value API was added merely to replace two immutable default values or numeric invalid-ID spelling.

spec.initial: Keyed featherProfile omitted; inspector-only cancellation; rewindable allocator watermarks; zero keyed featherFalloff; absent exact mask demand
spec.resolution: Sampler applies all supported scoped channels; native Escape/Undo history owner; monotonic whole-value edit watermarks; strictly positive falloff domain shared by static/keyed authoring; explicit existing named mask channel demand preserves zero-fill for truly missing channels; static geometry remains shared and all supported sampled properties, including Choice ramps, are validated through the existing value domain
spec.additions: Analytic PAR rotation, ancestor/point scaled feather and 8-sample exposure regressions; retained geometry test asserts positive charge before retirement
spec.interface_decision: Explicit network/node/group adapter factory replaces implicit active-node lookup; private integration detail preserving independent group clocks, not a new product behavior
